candidates.description: This vector activates on tokens containing the letter 'y' or the 'y' sound, often appearing as common prefixes, suffixes, or abbreviations.
This vector is related to common grammatical pronouns and conjunctions frequently found at the beginning of clauses.
This vector activates for German quantifiers, adjectives of difference, and numbers indicating plurality or variety.
This vector activates strongly for German personal pronouns and morphologically similar capitalized or lowercase tokens.
This vector represents adjectives and adverbs denoting physical size, scale, or degree in German and English.
This feature represents Greek grammatical suffixes and plural noun endings.
This feature activates for terms and roots associated with ancient Greek history, mythology, and culture.
This vector activates on Nordic or Germanic characters with umlauts and specific Scandinavian-language subword suffixes.
This feature vector activates strongly on the letter sequence "io" and related morphological suffixes or roots containing those characters.
This vector represents German adjective suffixes and inflections.
